evaluation.scope: Approximately one-hour post-release observation; baseline was captured after deployment, not a randomized pre-deployment control.
evaluation.conclusion: Competitive improvement not demonstrated; observed rank worsened14→15 while absolute deals/revenue increased and displayed overall stars held4.61. Attribution remains unresolved.
evaluation.ratio_limit: Incremental aggregate ratio,not a matched-customer conversion probability; visits and settlements can occur in different intervals.

latest_review_window.limit: Overlapping changing windows with different evaluators,not ten new reviews or a cohort-controlled rating effect.
